title: Interface-Capturing Schemes for Multiphase Flow Simulation
summary: Developing accurate interface-capturing and interface-orientation methods for multiphase CFD solvers.
description: This project focuses on numerical and data-driven schemes for representing sharp interfaces in multiphase-flow simulations. It connects VOF-based interface-orientation prediction, THINC-type reconstruction, and practical solver development for free-surface and interfacial flow problems.

title: Renewable Energy Systems: Airborne Wind, Tidal Turbines, and Energy Harvesting
summary: Consolidating renewable-energy research across airborne wind systems, tidal turbines, bio-inspired rotors, and flow-induced harvesting.
description: This project brings together renewable-energy work spanning airborne wind energy systems, tidal turbine simulations, bio-inspired wind and marine energy concepts, and flow-induced or piezoelectric energy harvesting. The work combines CFD, control, state estimation, structural analysis, and deployment-oriented system studies.

title: Blended Wing UAV Design for Sustainable Aviation
summary: Designing and evaluating blended-wing unmanned aircraft for improved aerodynamic performance, stability, and control.
description: This project develops sustainable UAV concepts based on blended-wing-body configurations. It combines design, fabrication, aerodynamic analysis, stability and control assessment, and performance tools to support improved long-endurance unmanned aircraft concepts.

title: Urban Air Mobility and eVTOL Performance Optimization
summary: Optimizing eVTOL and quadplane aircraft concepts for urban air mobility, delivery, and climate-aware operation.
description: This project addresses design and control challenges for electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft. It connects quadplane performance optimization, last-mile delivery concepts, real-flight-path tracking, and nonlinear model predictive control for rotorcraft and hybrid UAV platforms.

title: Wave Impact, Sloshing, and Free-Surface Flow Simulation
summary: Investigating violent free-surface flows, sloshing impacts, and dam-break interactions through simulation and experiment.
description: This project brings together work on sloshing mitigation, dam-break impact, unstructured mesh solvers, THINC/UMTHINC interface capturing, and experimental validation of violent free-surface flow problems. The research supports safer marine, offshore, and tank-design applications.

title: High-Order Methods for Multiphase Flow Simulation
summary: Applying high-order flux-reconstruction methods to multiphase-flow and interface-tracking problems.
description: This project focuses on high-order numerical methods for multiphase flows, including flux reconstruction, phase-field preconditioning, and PyFR-based solver development. The demonstrations highlight Rayleigh-Taylor instability and bubble-rise simulations using high-order multiphase formulations.

title: Autonomous UAV Systems for Emergency and Remote Operations
summary: Developing autonomous UAV platforms and control workflows for emergency response, mapping, agriculture, and remote-area operation.
description: This project focuses on UAV system integration, autonomous control, and mission-oriented deployment. It connects modular UAV development, drone-based data collection, robotic-arm emergency applications, and human-interface concepts for instrumented-glove flight control.
